n: <int> Number of tasks (and agents) to be matched one-to-one.
p: <int> Number of distinct performance criteria evaluated for each assignment.
cost_matrices: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [p][n][n]> Cost of assigning task i to agent j under criterion k.
ideal_point: <list[int], length p> Best achievable total cost for each criterion when that criterion is optimized independently.
nadir_approximation: <list[int], length p> Worst total cost observed for each criterion across the set of individually optimal solutions.
reference_point: <list[float], length p> Target total cost for each criterion that the assignment should aim toward.
search_direction_lambda: <list[float], length p> Weight controlling how deviations from the target are scaled for each criterion.
